A FEEL-GOOD GAME OF GRAVITY

Easy to roll.
Lovely to master.

L

Find your line

Steer with the left stick or WASD / arrows. Momentum matters. Ease off before a turn.

L2

Make it stick

Hold L2 or K to brake. Ice is slippery; braking brings back control.

×

A little lift

Press Cross or Space to hop over gaps and sweepers. Hold a direction into the jump.

□

A little push

Press Square or Shift for a pulse of speed. It recharges in three seconds.

FOLLOW THE LITTLE SUNS.

Gold shards add 1 second. Hourglasses add 8. Green rings save checkpoints. Falling costs 4 seconds, then you’re back. Reach the glowing gate before time runs out.

△ / R returns to your checkpoint (−4s). R1 / O gives an overview. Options / Esc pauses. Finish quickly and collect shards for medals.

MADE FOR THE JOY OF THE ROLL

Marble Daybreak.

An original, three-course spiritual successor to Marble Madness (Arcade / NES). A love letter to impossible little worlds, expressive momentum, and the very last second.

DATE2026-10-20 06:55 · America/Vancouver

SOURCEMarble Madness Arcade / NES

TECHThree.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPU only, Rapier 0.19.3, Web Audio, Gamepad API, HTML / CSS / JavaScript

ARTCel-shaded ceramic dioramas, ink outlines, sunrise pastels. Original procedural art and synthesized music.

ENVIRONMENTCodex CLI · Ubuntu 26.04 / WSL2 · Google Chrome 154.0.8037.57

MODELOpenAI · gpt-6.1-sol · max reasoning effort (user-selected configuration)

USAGEAPI cost unknown; approximately 320,000 goal-reported tokens; approximately 43 minutes elapsed (recorded at packaging).

All game art, courses and audio are original. Three.js: MIT. Rapier: Apache-2.0. Barlow Condensed and DM Sans: SIL Open Font License. Full notices are embedded in this file. No source-game assets used.
